svg.title: Kannappan Suresh, Backend & AI Engineer
svg.desc: Raw input wavers into a glowing, probabilistic LLM core held inside four still deterministic rings: grounded retrieval, validation rules, human-in-the-loop, audit trail. One straight line leaves, tagged cited, validated, audit-ready. Results: extraction accuracy ~70% to ~90%; weeks to ~1 day per new agent; Venmo migration ~30% faster; 60M+ records, zero data loss.
